    3: S90 W4-2 — S90-W1-1-EMPIRICAL-ANCHOR-1-458-PROMOTION-STATUS-VERIFY (CF-38)

   15:   (b) `alpha_LRD_FW` canonical pin in
   16:       computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py with substrate-
   17:       derived PROVENANCE entry.
   18: 
   19: PASS iff (a) ∨ (b)   → CF-37 Sub-clause B tightens 30% → 10% RATIO
   20: FAIL iff ¬(a) ∧ ¬(b) → CF-37 Sub-clause B retains default 30% RATIO
   21: INFO iff partial-promotion (STAGE-1-CANDIDATE / STAGE-2 only)

   24: is required. FAIL here is documentation-truthful (anchor not yet promoted),
   25: NOT a substrate-physics failure (per plan §W4-2 §13 substrate-framing
   26: reminder).
   27: 
   28: Plan reference: sessions/session-plan/session-90-plan-w4.md §W4-2.
